title: Thresholding Classifiers to Maximize F1 Score
study_context: Theoretical and experimental analysis of F1-maximizing classification thresholds.
population_or_data: Theoretical and experimental analysis of F1-maximizing classification thresholds.
main_findings: For well-calibrated conditional probabilities, the F1-optimal threshold is half the optimal F1; for an uninformative classifier, maximizing F1 can label every example positive.
limitations: Selected-page review only: PDF p.1, Abstract. Text extracted and page visually checked on 2026-10-07.
Author arXiv version v2, 2014-05-14; title follows this acquired version.
Transfer to cardiac WSI MIL requires qualification.
does_not_establish: The half-F1 rule cannot be applied directly to uncalibrated SMC scores; this reviewed abstract does not establish an F2 rule or a clinically optimal cutoff.
relevance_to_project: F1 optimization depends on score properties and the evaluation objective rather than a universal cutoff of 0.5.
